paper_title: Lossy-and-Constrained Extended Non-Local Games with Applications to Quantum Cryptography
statement: Security for the n-fold parallel repetition for a given n can be computed analogously. Since our techniques do run into a practical limit when increasing n, we leave the open problem to create a more efficient program that computes the parallel repetition faster.
